description.content: Turn a free-text place or address string into structured GeoJSON results with coordinates, ranked by relevance.

query.description: (Required) Your Geocode Earth API key.
(Required) The place or address to search for.
Maximum number of results to return (default 10).
Comma-separated list of layers to search, e.g. venue, address, street, locality, region, country, or the coarse alias.
Comma-separated list of data sources to query, e.g. osm (OpenStreetMap), oa (OpenAddresses), wof (Who's on First), gn (Geonames).
Restrict results to one or more ISO 3166-1 country codes.
Minimum longitude of a bounding rectangle filter.
Minimum latitude of a bounding rectangle filter.
Maximum longitude of a bounding rectangle filter.
Maximum latitude of a bounding rectangle filter.
Latitude of the center of a bounding circle filter.
Longitude of the center of a bounding circle filter.
Radius of the bounding circle filter, in kilometers.
Latitude used to prioritize results near a given location.
Longitude used to prioritize results near a given location.
Preferred response language as an ISO 639-1 or 639-3 code, used to localize result labels where translations are available.

County or administrative subdivision below region.
State, province, or region.
Postal or ZIP code.

Comma-separated list of layers to search, e.g. venue, address, street, locality, region, country, or the coarse alias.

description.content:
Hosted geocoding and address autocomplete API built on the open-source Pelias geocoder. Provides forward (search), autocomplete, reverse, and structured geocoding plus place lookup over open data sources (OpenStreetMap, OpenAddresses, Who's on First, and Geonames). All responses are GeoJSON FeatureCollections. Authentication is via an api_key query string parameter.

 Name: Geocode Earth Support
 Email: hello@geocode.earth
